_why: What must be TRUE on the live host after a deploy — the half that closes 'shipped is not verified'.
Read by scripts/predeploy-check.mjs --live, which runs automatically as the last step of npm run deploy:home.
Each marker is a string that only appears if the page actually rendered its own content, so a page that
deployed-but-did-not-land fails loudly instead of returning a cheerful 200. Pick markers that would DISAPPEAR
if the thing broke: a heading the page owns, an element id its script fills, a function name in a module.
A marker that can never fail is worse than no marker — it buys false confidence. Add a page here the same
day you add it to public/, or it ships unwatched.
NOTE: signed-in surfaces cannot be asserted from here. /status's Operations section, the runbook documents
and /admin's member table are all injected only after Firebase sign-in, which this unauthenticated fetch
never has. The markers below are therefore the page CHROME and its gate — proof the shell shipped, never
proof the gated content works. That still has to be checked by signing in.
The library2 ("Sam's library", padhard.heygabi.ai) role federation, 2026-08-16. The role CELLS are
injected only after Firebase sign-in, so what CAN be asserted unauthenticated is the module's own site
list: if padhard.heygabi.ai is not in the shipped admin.js, the fourth role column cannot exist.
The ebook permission gate (estate_auth 0008, owner directive 2026-08-17). Member rows are injected
only after Firebase sign-in, so what CAN be asserted unauthenticated is that the shipped bundle
carries the fifth catalog and the note that replaced the download toggle.
⚠️ THE MARKERS CHANGED 2026-08-17. They used to assert the DOWNLOAD CHECKBOX and its endpoint
('download-ebooks', 'download_ebooks_granted'). The owner removed that control the day after it
shipped — 'For ebooks I don't want a download check box, I want to use roles we have. Set up the
roles to match library.' Downloading is now the audiobook ladder's `download` capability (floor
admin), granted by promotion on the Audiobook role dropdown. A bundle that still carried the old
markers would be a bundle that still shipped the checkbox, so asserting them would now be exactly
backwards — mustNotContain pins the removal instead.
mustContain: download: admin on the audiobook role above

_why: /series (2026-08-17) is a GATED page: /api/series and /api/series/:slug both sit below the index
Worker's requireEstateMember() blanket, so every series row, every volume and every gap row is
injected only after a Firebase sign-in this unauthenticated fetch never has. What CAN be asserted
here is the SHELL and its gate: the heading, the back arrow, the ids the script fills, and the
sign-in button that is the signed-out state's whole content. The volume view itself, including the
gap rows, has to be checked by signing in — said plainly rather than implied by a green check.
The page's whole behaviour lives in this module, so the markers are the three things whose absence
would mean it shipped without its reason to exist: the gap sentence the owner asked for, the
source→household vocabulary that names who holds a volume, and the detail endpoint it expands with.
mustContain: nobody in the estate has this one
